verdict.rationale: VLP's Emerging Growth Companies & VC page states an early-stage financing practice. It lists angel and seed financings and convertible debt and bridge loans, and says the firm prepares and negotiates the financing documents for startups and seed investors. SAFEs are never named, though, and there are no published explainers or forms, so deep SAFE expertise is only implied by the general convertible-debt and seed language. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE or pre-seed experience, published explainers or forms, deal examples or independent corroboration.
